# The Relationship Between U.S. Stock Market Returns and Treasury Bond Yields: A Statistical Analysis

I am comparing the 10 year bond and the stock market from 2000 to current day. My sources are yahoo financial for the Treasury Bond and the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED.

```{r}
#| label: Loaded Data
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)
fredr_has_key()

getSymbols(
  "^GSPC",
  src= "yahoo",
  from = "2000-01-01",
  to = "2026-08-20"
)

sp500 <- data.frame(
  date = index(GSPC), 
  sp500 = as.numeric(Cl(GSPC))
)

treasury10 <- fredr(
  series_id = "DGS10",
  observation_start = as.Date("2000-01-01")
)|>
  select(date, value)|>
  rename(treasury10 = value)


stock_bond <- sp500|>
  inner_join(treasury10, by = "date")

range(sp500$date)
range(treasury10$date)
range(stock_bond$date)

```

```{r}
#| label: Change/Return
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

stock_bond <- stock_bond |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(
    sp500_return = (sp500 / lag(sp500)) - 1,
    treasury10_change = treasury10 - lag(treasury10)
  )

head(stock_bond)
```

```{r}
#| label: CleanStockBond
#| include: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

stock_bond_clean <- stock_bond |>
  drop_na(sp500_return, treasury10_change)

summary(stock_bond_clean)
```

```{r}
#| label: SP500&10TGraph
#| echo: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(stock_bond, aes(x = date, y = sp500)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(
    title = "S&P 500 Perfomance, 2000-2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "S&P 500"
  )

ggplot(stock_bond, aes(x = date, y = treasury10)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(
    title = "10-Year U.S. Treasury Yield, 2000-2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "10-Year Treasury Yield(%)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: Scatterplot
#| echo: false
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(
  stock_bond_clean,
  aes(
    x = treasury10_change,
    y = sp500_return
  )
) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
  labs(
    title = "S&P 500 Returns vs. 10-Year Treasury Yield Changes",
    x = "Change in 10-Year Treasury Yield",
    y = "S&P 500 Daily Return"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: Line Regression
library(quantmod)
library(fredr)
library(tidyverse)

model1 <- lm(
  sp500_return ~ treasury10_change, 
  data = stock_bond_clean
)

summary(model1)
```
